meta.title: Create Proposal produces a draft proposal
gaps: The fixed prepared state already contains a draft proposal, so the Allocate → award → Create Proposal transition and its creation outcome cannot be tested from the required starting state.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: The fixed prepared state already contains a draft proposal, so the Allocate → award → Create Proposal transition and its creation outcome cannot be tested from the required starting state.

steps.note: Open the prepared event with its existing draft award proposal.
Open the existing proposal from Master QCS.
Verify that a real proposal page opens.
Require visible evidence that the proposal remains a draft rather than a submitted award.
Explicitly fail if the submit control is missing; its absence must not count as success.
Inspect the allocation retained on the draft proposal.
Verify the allocation identifies the prepared event's expected vendor.
Verify the allocated line displays the expected quantity.
Verify the allocated line displays the expected unit.
